## 05 · Generate Newsletter
One authenticated webhook (Header Auth credential) with three actions: generate {week, runId}, status {runId}, artifact {runId}. Called only by the Next.js server.

generate validates the week (1-5, topic configured in web/src/lib/weeks.ts), reuses an in-progress run for that week, inserts a newsletter_runs row and responds at once. It then runs 01 Fetch (Yellowdig only, no fixture fallback) -> 02 Normalize -> week assets from newsletter_assets (workflow profiles and screenshots stored by the private intake script; none means coverage unknown) -> editorial input -> 04 Editorial Intelligence (Gemini, evidence review, at most 2 revisions) -> render (web/src/lib/render/newsletter.ts) -> store the HTML. Any failure stores failed with a safe code.

Statuses: queued, fetching_yellowdig, generating_editorial, rendering, ready, ready_with_omissions, failed. The manual trigger runs the synthetic fixture with the mock model only.

observatory.note: Credentials, pinned data, webhook ids and instance metadata removed. Code nodes are generated; see web/scripts/build-n8n.ts.
